AC: Reproduce create_pipenv.sh imgcomp in a fresh worktree; identify hang root cause; fix or document reliable venv setup path.

Body.raw:
Investigate whether create_pipenv.sh reliably sets up project .venv (worktrees, detached HEAD, Cursor agent shells).

create_pipenv.sh prints :success or :failure lines on stderr, plus an action line pointing here.

## Record a datapoint (WorkItem)

From the utils repo root, when you see a todo line from create_pipenv.sh:

```bash
TODO=skills/projectmanagement/todos/todo.py
"$TODO" ensure_worktree b6f4df78 --init
cd "$("$TODO" ensure_worktree b6f4df78 | jq -r .worktree)"
"$TODO" work-item-add b6f4df78 --summary=":success create_pipenv PROJECT"
"$TODO" work-item-done b6f4df78 --checkpoint -m "WHY: paste the reason from the todo line"
```

Replace :success with :failure when the script line says :failure. Replace PROJECT with the project path from the line (e.g. imgcomp). The checkpoint -m message is the why (text after -- on the todo line).

## Example WorkItem

- summary: `:failure create_pipenv imgcomp`
- checkpoint -m: `Hung 4+ min, zero stdout in utils-imgcomp-master-aug27 worktree. Why: Cursor shell harness blocked on cat before create_pipenv ran; manual python3 -m venv succeeded in ~4s.`
